name: round-2353
title: Fix round #2353 (2026-10-19, P1): two circles, right-angled at X, regular polygons, 3-D sliver, 3-D coordinates, 3-D fractions

cases.title: A point stated on two circles sits on both (#2185)
lines: A על מעגל O ועל מעגל P
cases.lookFor: A sits on BOTH circles, green. Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת»: A stays at a crossing of O and P.
cases.before: A was put on circle O only, green.

cases.title: Two points on two circles each sit on both (#2185, riskiest)
lines: A ו-B על מעגל O ועל מעגל P
cases.lookFor: A and B each on both circles. At some configurations A and B coincide, exactly as the two-line form does.
cases.before: A and B were put on circle O only, green.

cases.title: «A על מעגל O ו-B על מעגל P» puts each point on its own circle (#2185)
lines: A על מעגל O ו-B על מעגל P
cases.lookFor: A on O and B on P. The line is drawn, with the tip «ציירנו את שני הנתונים שכתבתם בשורה אחת… כדאי להקליד נתון אחד בכל שורה».
cases.before: B was silently put on O.

cases.title: «בהתאמה» pairs the points with the circles (#2185)
lines: A ו-B על מעגל O ועל מעגל P בהתאמה
cases.lookFor: A on O and B on P. The line is drawn, with the tip «ציירנו את שני הנתונים שכתבתם בשורה אחת… כדאי להקליד נתון אחד בכל שורה».

cases.title: A point on both diagonals of a square is their crossing (#2185)
lines: P על האלכסון AC ועל האלכסון BD
cases.lookFor: P at the centre of the square, on both diagonals.

cases.title: Refusal: an arc midpoint on a circle the arc is not on is not drawn on another circle (#2185, withdrawn behaviour)
lines: F אמצע הקשת BC במעגל O
cases.lookFor: F is not drawn. The last line goes to the AI (on this server, with no model, it ends «לא הצלחתי לקרוא את זה עדיין…»).
cases.before: F was drawn on the OTHER circle, green.

cases.title: An arc midpoint with no circle named still builds (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: F drawn at the midpoint of arc BC, green.

cases.title: A chord of one circle tangent to another is drawn as both (#2197)
lines: AB מיתר במעגל O ומשיק למעגל P
cases.lookFor: Segment AB with A and B on circle O, touching circle P at a point inside AB, green.
cases.before: No segment AB at all; a tangent was drawn from P instead, green.

cases.title: A diameter of one circle tangent to another (#2197)
lines: AB קוטר במעגל O ומשיק למעגל P
cases.lookFor: A diameter AB of circle O (through O) touching circle P.
cases.before: A and B landed on the same point.

cases.title: A common tangent at a named point still builds (regression guard)
lines: AB משיק משותף למעגלים O ו-P בנקודה X
cases.lookFor: Builds green; the circles touch externally at X and AB is tangent there.

cases.title: Refusal: a chord of both circles is not drawn with one circle dropped (#2197)
lines: AB מיתר במעגל O ומיתר במעגל P
cases.lookFor: Nothing is committed; the line goes to the AI (here, with no model: «לא הצלחתי לקרוא את זה עדיין…»). Approved but NOT delivered: building it whole needs #1950.
cases.before: A chord of O only, circle P silently dropped, green.

cases.title: A chord tangent to two more circles goes to the AI instead of a self-conflict message (not asked for)
lines: AB מיתר במעגל O ומשיק למעגל P ולמעגל Q
cases.lookFor: Nothing is committed; the line goes to the AI. Judge whether this is acceptable.
cases.before: Refused with the «sentence contradicts itself» message.

cases.title: "right-angled at B" after a triangle is refused with the two lines, not drawn (#2234, riskiest)
cases.lookFor: «בכל שורה נתון אחד … (1) משולש ABC  (2) ∠ABC = 90°». No right angle drawn.
cases.before: ∠ABC = 90 was drawn green, with the note «∠ABC = 90».

cases.title: «המשולש ישר זווית ב-B» is refused with the two lines and never reaches the AI (#2234, your line)
cases.lookFor: The same two-line refusal. No «חושב…» spinner.

cases.title: "ABC is right-angled" still builds the right angle at B (riskiest, unchanged)
cases.lookFor: ∠ABC = 90 drawn green, with the note «נקלט. בפעם הבאה אפשר לכתוב כך: ∠ABC = 90».

cases.title: Refusal: the English named form gets the three-line teach (#2143 reversed)
lines: triangle ABC right-angled at B and AB = 4
cases.lookFor: «(1) משולש ABC  (2) ∠ABC = 90°  (3) AB = 4».
cases.before: A fragment list «(1) triangle ABC right-  (2) angled at B and AB = 4».

cases.title: Refusal: the bare phrase with two triangles at B lists the angles there
cases.lookFor: «בקודקוד B יש כמה זוויות…», with the example ∠ABC = 90.

cases.title: Refusal on a square's corner reuses «couldn't read this yet» (P1 message reuse)
cases.lookFor: «לא הצלחתי לקרוא את זה עדיין — נסו אחת מהדוגמאות למטה.» Nothing drawn, not sent to the AI.

cases.title: "the triangle is right-angled" invents no points T, R, I (#2234)
cases.lookFor: No new points T, R, I and no «∠TRI = 90» note; the line goes to the AI.
cases.before: Three new points T, R, I with a right angle, green.

cases.title: Refusal: "show all angles" gets the marks message
cases.lookFor: «סימונים על השרטוט… מופיעים אוטומטית…».

cases.title: Lowercase teaching still works on a drawn triangle (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: «שמות נקודות נכתבים באות לטינית גדולה. נסו: AB = 5».

cases.title: An English word on a drawn figure is not taught as capital letters
cases.lookFor: No «…the TOP…» nudge and nothing drawn; the line goes to the AI (here, with no model: «הבנתי את זה אבל זה לא יצר שום דבר באיור…»).

cases.title: A right angle stated as an angle still builds (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: ∠ABC = 90 drawn green.

cases.title: A drawn pentagon declared regular gets five equal sides (#2265)
cases.lookFor: All five sides equal, green.

cases.title: The same with the pentagon named (#2265)
cases.lookFor: Five equal sides.

cases.title: A drawn hexagon declared regular (#2265)
cases.lookFor: Six equal sides.

cases.title: A drawn octagon declared regular (#2265)
cases.lookFor: Eight equal sides.

cases.title: Refusal: «regular» against two stated unequal sides (#2265)
cases.lookFor: After a long «חושב…» (about 17 s, filed as #2359), the last line is refused: «לא ניתן: «המחומש משוכלל» סותר את «BC = 4» — אי אפשר לקיים את שניהם יחד». AB = 3 and BC = 4 stay.
cases._probe: verified-by-probe on main @ 2662bd4d: refused after 17.5 s with «לא ניתן: «המחומש משוכלל» סותר את «BC = 4» … הסיבה: |AB| = |BC|» (the square analog: 3.0 s). The slow wait is #2359.

cases.title: A regular pentagon typed in one line is unchanged (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: A regular pentagon, as before.

cases.title: Every other configuration stays a regular pentagon, never a star (#2265, riskiest)
cases.lookFor: Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» three times (each takes ~3.5 s): every drawing is a regular, convex pentagon, never a star.
cases._probe: verified-by-probe on main @ 2662bd4d: three presses, each settled in ~3.5 s; every drawing a regular pentagon (label-to-label sides 323 ×5 each time).

cases.title: An inscribed pentagon restated as regular becomes regular (#2265, another spelling)
cases.lookFor: A regular pentagon on the one drawn circle.

cases.title: «המחומש משוכלל» over an inscribed pentagon uses its circle (#2265, another spelling)
cases.lookFor: A regular pentagon on the ONE drawn circle; no collapsed vertices.
cases.before: Sides 0.08 / 9.98 / 0.01 / 7.45 / 6.14 on a second hidden circle, green.

cases.title: 3-D refusal: isosceles at B with a right angle at C cannot be a triangle (#2292)
cases.lookFor: The third line refused: «…מתקיימים רק אם המשולש ABC שטוח (כל קודקודיו על ישר אחד) — וקו ישר אינו משולש.» The triangle stays as before.
cases.before: All green, C drawn 0.003 from A (a sliver).

cases.title: 3-D refusal: the same with the ⊥ sign (#2292)
cases.lookFor: The same refusal, naming «AC ⊥ BC».

cases.title: 3-D refusal: the givens in reverse order (#2292)
cases.lookFor: Refused on the third line, naming «|BA| = |BC|» with «∠ACB = 90°».

cases.title: 3-D refusal: a right isosceles triangle with the right angle at C (#2292)
lines: משולש ישר זווית שווה שוקיים ABC
cases.lookFor: The second line refused, naming the first.

cases.title: 3-D: the other leg is still refused (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: The same refusal wording.

cases.title: 3-D: a real right triangle builds (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: All green: a 2-1-√3 triangle, right angle at C.

cases.title: 3-D: a very thin but real triangle still builds on every configuration (#2292, riskiest)
cases.lookFor: All green, a very flat but drawn triangle; «הציגו תצורה אחרת» never refuses it.

cases.title: 3-D: a needle-thin right triangle that is almost isosceles still builds
cases.lookFor: All green, a needle-thin right triangle.

cases.title: 3-D: one coordinate of B does not invent coordinates for A (#2340)
cases.lookFor: The data panel and the canvas show B(3, ?, ?) only. A has no coordinate row or label.

cases.title: 3-D: the same with the lowercase spelling on a cube (#2340)
3-D: the z of A given leaves its x and y unknown (#2340)
cases.before: A(0, 0, 2) shown as a known fact.

cases.title: 3-D: asking for an unstated coordinate gets an honest answer (#2340)
cases.lookFor: Type «x_A» in the «שאלו» box: the answer «לא נקבע על ידי הנתונים».

cases.title: 3-D: a plane's equation shows only when the givens fix it (#2340, riskiest)
cases.lookFor: The panel shows «ABCD: z - 2 = 0» with no parametric row, and NO equation for ABB'A'. Vertices read A(?, ?, 2) … A'(?, ?, 4).
cases.before: Every vertex had full coordinates, and «ABB'A': y = 0» was printed.

cases.title: 3-D: a fully placed box is unchanged (regression guard)
3-D: a point at a mixed-number coordinate (#2255)
cases.lookFor: A at x = 2.5 in the data panel.

cases.title: 3-D: a cube with a mixed-number edge (#2255, the reported case)
cases.lookFor: Edge 2.5, green; the same figure as «AB = 2.5».

cases.title: 3-D: a thirds coordinate (#2255)
3-D: the ½ palette button after a digit (#2255)
cases.lookFor: Type «AB = 2», press the ½ button on the palette, then Enter: |AB| = 2.5. (With ¾: 2.75.) The pre-play typed the glyph directly.

cases.title: 3-D: vector coefficients are unchanged (#2255, riskiest)
cases.lookFor: M at the centre of face ABCD, exactly as before.

cases.title: 3-D: an angle with a mixed number now builds (#2255)
cases.lookFor: The angle reads 22.5°.

cases.title: 3-D: a plane equation with a mixed number now builds (#2255)
cases.lookFor: A plane at z = 2.5, the same as «z - 2.5 = 0».

cases.title: «המעגלים O ו-P משיקים בנקודה X» after one circle now builds instead of a fragment list (side effect, not asked for)
lines: המעגלים O ו-P משיקים בנקודה X
cases.lookFor: Circle P is created touching circle O at X, green. Judge whether this is right.
cases.before: Refused with «(1) המעגלים O  (2) P משיקים בנקודה X» (measured at b7d6223c).
